title: HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Distance Measurement
objective: Verify an HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor is wired with correct trigger/echo pins and returns a plausible distance reading.
safety_notes: Echo pin should be used with a voltage divider if the board is 3.3V logic (not required for standard 5V Arduino UNO).

steps.title: Mount the sensor
steps.instruction: Place the HC-SR04 module on the breadboard or fixture with a clear line of sight to the target.

steps.title: Wire trigger and echo
steps.instruction: Connect TRIG to D9 and ECHO to D10 on the Arduino.

steps.title: Power the sensor
steps.instruction: Connect VCC to 5V and GND to GND.

steps.title: Measure distance
steps.instruction: Place an object roughly 10-100 cm away and confirm the reported distance is plausible.

validation_rules.description: TRIG must go to D9 and ECHO must go to D10.
Distance reading must fall within the sensor's valid operating range.

troubleshooting.reading_always_0: TRIG and ECHO pins may be swapped.
troubleshooting.reading_always_max: Check for a loose GND connection or an obstructed sensor face.
troubleshooting.erratic_readings: Target surface may be too soft/angled to reflect the pulse; try a flat hard surface.
